currency_note: All DCF values in GBP POUNDS per share. Live LSE quote (Yahoo WISE.L) is in PENCE (GBp); 914.4 GBp = £9.144. FY2026 official results are reported in USD under US GAAP post dual-listing; P&L flows converted to GBP at FY26 avg rate 1.34, balance-sheet at closing 1.3224. Underlying income (£1,609.2m) and cross-border volume (£181.7bn) taken directly from Wise's GBP-denominated Q4 FY26 trading update.

inputs.notes: Net debt = Total Debt (£253.1m) - distributable corporate cash (£1600.0m), excluding customer-attributable balances. Note: US GAAP B/S shows $14,824.1m own cash, but the bulk is held against customer activity / not freely distributable, so a conservative £1,600m distributable figure is used (consistent with prior FY25 basis of £1,430m). FY2026 ended 31 March 2026. FCF proxy = GBP-converted net income $498.7m/1.34.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: FY26 underlying income +18% to £1,609.2m. PBT margin compressed to 26% (US GAAP) / underlying PBT margin toward top of 13-16% as Wise reinvests. Selected 15% start = bottom of management 15-20% net-revenue CAGR medium-term guidance, conservative for take-rate compression (52bps).

calculation_notes.fcf_note: FY2026 FCF proxy £372.2m (net income, GBP). Up from £332.7m FY25.

base.rationale: 15% start = low end of management's 15-20% net-revenue CAGR guidance; decel to 8% on maturation. WACC 10% for tech with minimal leverage. Conservative vs USD net-revenue +19%.

bull.rationale: 20% achieves top of guidance; Wise Platform scales, instant payments 74%+, US dual-listing re-rating. Lower WACC on reduced execution risk.

bear.rationale: Take-rate compression (52->lower bps), Revolut/neobank competition, AML/regulatory and dual-listing costs, slower Platform scaling.

probability_weighted.interpretation: Probability-weighted IV £9.33 vs live price £9.144 (914.4 GBp).

live_price_check_8b.note: Yahoo returns LSE price in pence. Divided by 100 to get £9.144 to match DCF GBP/share units.

sanity_check_8c.notes: Live price £9.144 => trailing P/E ~25.3x on FY26 diluted EPS 36.14p. Market cap ~£9439m. Base IV £9.01 (P/E ~24.9x) implies -1.5% vs price; market prices in upper-half of guidance / dual-listing re-rating. Negative net debt from conservative £1.6bn distributable cash adds ~£1.30/share.

key_risks_to_valuation: Take-rate compression below 52bps if Revolut/banks compete on price
Underlying PBT margin (toward top of 13-16%) reinvestment cycle pressures reported profit
Wise Platform scaling slower than guidance
USD reporting transition / FX translation noise vs GBP price
Large customer-balance cash not distributable; capital-return optionality limited

valuation_summary.current_assessment: Live price £9.144 (914.4 GBp) vs base IV £9.01 => -1.5% vs base. FY26 delivered +18% underlying income (£1,609.2m) and net revenue +19% but PBT margin fell to 26% on reinvestment. New >$500m buyback announced.
valuation_summary.buy_recommendation: Base-case IV near current price; limited margin of safety at £9.14. Accumulate on weakness toward weighted IV.
catalysts_for_upside: US dual-listing institutional demand / index inclusion
Geographic expansion: Brazil, Japan, UAE, Thailand, South Africa

sensitivity.current_price_location: Live price £9.144 (914.4 GBp) sits near base IV at WACC 10%/terminal 3%.
sensitivity.interpretation: IV highly sensitive to WACC. At WACC 9%, terminal 3%, IV = £10.33.
